claims.text: An in-situ measurement technique can accurately determine melting temperature in high-entropy alloys.
An in-situ measurement technique can accurately determine enthalpy of fusion in high-entropy alloys.
An in-situ measurement technique can accurately determine entropy of fusion in high-entropy alloys.
An in-situ measurement technique can accurately determine volume change at melting in high-entropy alloys.
An in-situ measurement technique can accurately determine liquid-phase thermodynamic properties in high-entropy alloys.
High-temperature calorimetry or X-ray diffraction can serve as the proposed in-situ measurement method.
Direct probing during melting provides the mechanism for determining the thermodynamic properties.
The proposed technique will determine the thermodynamic properties more efficiently than prior experimental and modeling methods.
The proposed approach is applicable across the high-entropy-alloy family.
Failure to improve accuracy and efficiency significantly relative to prior methods would falsify the hypothesis.
